sloka: अराक्षसमिमं लोकं कर्तास्मि निशितैः शरैः ।न चेच्छरणमभ्येषि मामुपादाय मैथिलीम् ।। ६.४१.६६ ।।।।
transliteration: arākṣasamimaṁ lokaṁ kartāsmi niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ।na ceccharaṇamabhyeṣi māmupādāya maithilīm ।। 6.41.66 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasa! Even Devatas, sages and even royal sages have also lost their lives, killed by me."
